## Plot the geography of Kampala
```{r}
# Define the color palette and class names
landcover_colors <- c(
  "10" = "#006400",  # Tree cover
  "20" = "#ffbb22",  # Shrubland
  "30" = "#ffff4c",  # Grassland
  "40" = "#f096ff",  # Cropland
  "50" = "#fa0000",  # Built-up
  "60" = "#b4b4b4",  # Bare/sparse vegetation
  "70" = "#f0f0f0",  # Snow and Ice
  "80" = "#0064c8",  # Permanent water bodies
  "90" = "#0096a0",  # Herbaceous wetland
  "95" = "#00cf75",  # Mangroves
  "100" = "#fae6a0", # Moss and lichen
  "0" = NA           # No data
)

landcover_classes <- c(
  "10" = "Tree cover",
  "20" = "Shrubland",
  "30" = "Grassland",
  "40" = "Cropland",
  "50" = "Built-up",
  "60" = "Bare/Sparse vegetation",
  "70" = "Snow and Ice",
  "80" = "Permanent water bodies",
  "90" = "Herbaceous wetland",
  "95" = "Mangroves",
  "100" = "Moss and lichen",
  "0" = "No data"
)

# Filter landcover colors and classes to include only those present in the data
unique_classes <- sort(unique(values(Landcover)))  # Get unique values in the raster and sort them in ascending order

# Remove snow and ice as it is not present in the data
unique_classes <- unique_classes[unique_classes != 70]

# Filter the color and class vectors
filtered_landcover_colors <- landcover_colors[names(landcover_colors) %in% unique_classes]
filtered_landcover_classes <- landcover_classes[names(landcover_classes) %in% unique_classes]

# Generate slope and aspect from the DEM
slope <- terrain(DEM, "slope")       # Calculate slope
aspect <- terrain(DEM, "aspect")     # Calculate aspect

# Generate hillshade
hillshade <- shade(slope, aspect, angle = 45, direction = 315)  # Customize lighting

# Filter facilities data into HC facilities and hospitals
facilities = Facilities[[1]]  # Filter healthcare facilities

# Group the facilities into different categories
hospitals <- facilities[facilities$Facility_t %in% c("National Referral Hospital", "Hospital", "Regional Referral Hospital"), ]
health_centres <- facilities[facilities$Facility_t %in% c("Health Centre III", "Health Centre II", "Health Centre IV"), ]

# Set tighter margins for the legend
par(oma = c(0, 0, 0, 0), mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))  # Outer and inner margins reduced

# Load the complete landcover raster
landcover_complete <- rast(here("Data", "raw", "Landcover", "ESA_WorldCover_10m_2021_v200_N00E030_Map.tif"))

landcover_complete <- project(landcover_complete, Landcover)
landcover_complete <- crop(landcover_complete, ext(Landcover))
landcover_complete <- mask(landcover_complete, Landcover, inverse = TRUE)

# 1. Plot the background landcover (non-Kampala area only; low opacity)
plot(
  landcover_complete,
  col = adjustcolor(
    filtered_landcover_colors,
    alpha.f = 0.15
  ),
  legend = FALSE,
  axes = FALSE,
  box = FALSE,
)

# Plot the landcover map 
Landcover %>%
plot(
  col = adjustcolor(filtered_landcover_colors, alpha.f = 0.7),  # Set alpha to 1 (fully opaque)
  legend = FALSE,  # Disable automatic legend
  axes = FALSE,  # Remove axes and labels
  box = TRUE,  # Keep the plot box
  cex.main = 1.5,  # Adjust title font size
  add = TRUE 
) %>%
{
  # Overlay the hillshade
  plot(hillshade, col = gray.colors(100, start = 0.3, end = 1, alpha = 0.4), legend = FALSE, add = TRUE)
  # Overlay the OSM roads
  lines(OSM_roads, col = "black", lwd = 1.5, lty = 1)
  # Overlay the water lines
  lines(water_lines, col = "blue", lwd = 1, lty = 2)
  # Add hospitals
  points(hospitals, pch = 23, col = "black", bg = "blue", cex = 2)
  # Add health centers
  points(health_centres, pch = 21, col = "black", bg = "green", cex = 2)
  # Add the Legend
  legend(
    x = "bottomleft",
    inset = c(0.09, 0.01),  # Adjust inset to fit the map
    legend = c(filtered_landcover_classes, "Rivers", "Roads"),  # Filtered class names, rivers, roads
    fill = c(filtered_landcover_colors, "blue", "black"),  # Matching filtered colors, blue for rivers, black for roads
    border = "white",  # Legend border
    bg = "white",  # Legend background
    cex = 1.5,  # Adjust text size
    title = "Landcover Classes",
    ncol = 2,
    x.intersp = 0.1,  # Decrease spacing between columns
    y.intersp = 0.7,  # Decrease spacing between rows
    text.width = NA  # Adjust text width
  )
  legend(
    x = "bottomleft",
    inset = c(0.09, 0.175),  # Adjust inset to fit above the landcover legend
    legend = c("Hospitals", "Health Centers"),  # Legend for hospitals and health centers
    pch = c(23, 21),  # Symbols for hospitals and health centers
    col = "black",  # Black border for symbols
    pt.bg = c("blue", "green"),  # Fill colors for hospitals and health centers
    pt.cex = 2,  # Adjust point size
    title = "Healthcare Facilities",
    bg = "white",  # Legend background
    cex = 1.5,  # Adjust text size
    x.intersp = 0.5,  # Adjust spacing between symbols and text
    y.intersp = 0.8  # Adjust spacing between rows
  )
  sbar(2000, xy = "bottomright", type = "bar", divs = 4, below = "km", cex = 1.2, lonlat = FALSE, scaleby = 1000)
  north(type = 2, cex = 1.5)
}
```
